slice: PR 1 of 2: buoyancy physics in the core model, stepped in legacy frames and replayed against two legacy recordings; save v5
command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run license-check && npm run sites:check && npm run devcontainer:check && npm run build && npm run dist:check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:parity && npm run pixi:visual-check && npm run interior:check && npx playwright test
workingTree: clean before the run and still clean after it
timestampProvenance: Both are `date -u` output printed around the run.
provenanceNote: The full run above is on 87ee573. 57f1ef0 then adds one unit test (tests/unit/buoyancy.test.ts); src and scripts are identical to the measured tree, and typecheck, lint, unit and parity were rerun on 57f1ef0 (see followUp). The only later commit updates this file.
earlierRuns: A first full run on a22b0ce, the same change before an amend, failed 2 Playwright tests in tests/in-dive-controls.spec.js that pinned the save at version 4 (expected 4, received 5). They now assert the version they rely on: at least v3 for the dive mode, at least v4 for CNS. Both passed alone (14 of 14 in the gas information group) and in the full run above.

A full run on 7692e30 passed (298 unit, 56 parity, 139 e2e). The pre-review of #193, pass 1, then found that inflating from a diluent holding less than one step's draw could throw (p - (p * v) / v one ulp below zero). 8c42fed fixes it and adds a unit test that throws a RangeError without the fix; the run above is on that commit.

A full run on 8c42fed passed (299 unit, 56 parity, 139 e2e). Codex round 1 then found that the model batched a whole second of BCD controls before any motion, which legacy never does with a control held (fast-forward is off, a frame is at most 0.3 s of dive time), and that the #192 departure had no parity test. cd22afc re-records both buoyancy scenarios in 60 Hz frames and adds buoyancy-ccr-inflate-12m; 87ee573 steps the model in 0.1 s frames and adds the departure test. The run above is on 87ee573.

results.distCheck: pass: 17 files scanned, no source maps, 4 diagnostic markers absent
results.unit: 301 passed on 87ee573 (286 on main, +11 in tests/unit/buoyancy.test.ts, +4 in tests/unit/save-game.test.ts); 302 on 57f1ef0
results.parity: 61 passed (49 on main, +4 in tests/parity/buoyancy.test.ts, +8 planner checkpoints the two new scenarios add to tests/parity/dive-planner.test.ts)
results.e2e: 139 passed in 4.9 min (unchanged count; tests/baseline.spec.js pins the two new scenarios in its existing list)

parity.cadence: Both scenarios hold keys in 60 Hz frames (scripts/baseline-scenarios.cjs holdKeys): updateDiving(1/60 s real), 0.05 s of dive time, the cadence the legacy game loop runs at. The model replays one advanceWithBuoyancy() call per frame.

buoyancy-vent-inflate-12m.recording: rec setup on the geometry-free open site, one air cylinder, neutralizeAt(12) at rest; S held 4 s, nothing 20 s, W held 11 s, nothing 30 s.

checkpoints.inflated-11s: depth 22.547, velocity 5.107 (slowed by the inflation, still descending, below both limits; the diver turns during the coast), BCD 13.889 L
checkpoints.coasting-30s: depth 16.220, velocity -25 (the ascent limit, reached as the BCD expands)

buoyancy-vent-inflate-12m.compared: Depth after each of the 1,300 frames; velocity, BCD gas, CNS, cylinder gas and the 16 N2 compartments at each checkpoint, at the fixture's absoluteEpsilon.

buoyancy-ccr-inflate-12m.recording: CCR at 1.3 bar with air diluent, neutral at 12 m; W held 2 s, nothing 8 s.

checkpoints.inflated-2s: depth 11.949, velocity -4.371, BCD 8.625 L; legacy placeholder tank down 1.759 L, diluent 200 bar

buoyancy-ccr-inflate-12m.compared: Depth after each of the 200 frames; velocity, BCD gas, CNS, N2 compartments, loop pO2, O2 cylinder and scrubber with legacy. The departure: legacy's placeholder lost exactly the BCD gain, the migration's placeholder is untouched, and its diluent pressure equals legacy's minus that gain over the cylinder volume (0.586 bar lower).

parity.noFailure: Legacy does not end either dive, and the model's failure stays null throughout.

fixtureRegeneration.legacyChange: src/game-loop.js captureBaselineCheckpoint() gains state.bcdGasSurface_l, an additive field as docs/decisions.md 'Trace contract limits' allows.
fixtureRegeneration.additiveCheck: The fixture before (at d6b4788) and after (generated from cd22afc) were compared scenario by scenario: air-18m-30min, trimix-45m-20min, ccr-30m-30min, ccr-bailout-30m, ccr-setpoint-bailout-30m and tec-switch-21m are byte-identical, and the header differs only in referenceCommit. Against the fixture on main the same six differ only by the added state.bcdGasSurface_l, checked at the first regeneration.

counterChecks.method: Each revert was applied to src/core/buoyancy.ts or src/core/dive-model.ts from a backup copy, tests/parity/buoyancy.test.ts, tests/unit/buoyancy.test.ts and tests/unit/save-game.test.ts were run, then the file was restored from the backup; the working tree was clean afterwards. Run on 57f1ef0 (the physics reverts) and on 87ee573 (the cadence and departure reverts).

results.result: 1 failed: "integrates a longer span in legacy's 0.1 s physics sub-steps"

results.revert: wetsuit lift not compressing with pressure
results.result: 3 failed: both parity replays and "holds a diver at rest where it is neutral"

results.revert: advanceWithBuoyancy() frames of 1 s (FIXED_STEP_SECONDS), the batching Codex round 1 found
results.result: 2 failed: "runs a one-second step as ten 0.1 s frames" and "does not vent the whole second before the diver moves"; the parity replays pass, since a 0.05 s frame is one frame either way

results.revert: inflation drawn from tanks[activeTank] on a rebreather, as legacy

departures.ccrBcdFromDiluent: Owner decision on #192: on a rebreather the BCD inflates from the diluent cylinder, not tanks[activeTank]. Recorded in docs/decisions.md "Deliberate departures from the legacy client"; proven by the declared-departure parity test on buoyancy-ccr-inflate-12m and pinned by tests/unit/buoyancy.test.ts.

durableProvenance.note: src and scripts as measured on 87ee573; tests as on 57f1ef0.

followUp.change: Adds the unit test "integrates a longer span in legacy's 0.1 s physics sub-steps": with the model stepping in 0.1 s frames the parity replay no longer reaches integrateBuoyancy()'s sub-step loop, and the single-step counter-check passed every test until this was added.
